meta.title: Trouble Ticket Lifecycle — Creation, Assignment, Resolution & Closure

lanes.name: Agent / Supervisor
lanes.hint: Call Centre, Retail, Telesales and Back Office agents and supervisors

lanes.name: DXP
lanes.hint: Digital experience platform UI, smart search, knowledge base access, AI-assisted triage

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: System of record for ticket, assignment, SLA, audit, resolution

lanes.name: Privileged Admin
lanes.hint: Template, hashtag, actual-issue, distribution-list, reopen and cancellation privilege holders

lanes.name: External Systems
lanes.hint: AIA, Notification Platform / SMS-WhatsApp Gateway, Medelia, MNP Gateway, Knowledge Base

nodes.label: Agent Login Trigger
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to log in to the system using Agent ID and password.

nodes.label: Validate Credentials
nodes.desc: The system shall validate the Agent ID and credentials before granting access.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access
nodes.desc: The system shall provide role-based view and edit options to the authenticated agent.

nodes.label: View Agent 360
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to view Agent 360 after successful login.

nodes.label: Agent Dashboard
nodes.desc: The system shall display the tickets, tasks, etc. assigned to the logged-in agent (reuse of BRSD Agent 360).

nodes.label: Validate Q Ticket & Identify Customer
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to validate the Q Ticket and identify the customer before initiating a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Customer Identification
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to complete customer identification before initiating a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Navigate to Customer 360
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to navigate to Customer 360 before initiating Ticket. Reuse the requirements defined in BRSD customer 360.

nodes.label: Verify by IDwise
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to verify the customer by scanning the ID by retail agent only, before initiating a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Verify by Telesales/Retail Question
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to verify the customer by asking a verification question, by Telesales and Retail agent, before initiating a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Smart Search for Categorisation
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to search by keyword to identify the applicable ticket category before raising a ticket.

nodes.label: Create Manual Trouble Ticket
nodes.desc: The system shall create a ticket automatically with a unique Ticket ID according to the selected category when the agent raises a ticket manually.

nodes.label: Auto-Populate Ticket Fields
nodes.desc: The system shall auto-populate the ticket fields identified as auto-populated in the source requirement.

nodes.label: Capture Manually Filled Fields
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to enter the ticket fields identified as manually filled in the source requirement.

nodes.label: Automatic TT on Order Failure
nodes.desc: The system shall automatically create a Trouble Ticket when an order creation request received from AIA fails and record the error reason in the Description field.

nodes.label: Knowledge Base Access
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to open the knowledge base from the system in another tab through a button.

nodes.label: View Newly Created Trouble Ticket
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to view the newly created Trouble Ticket with its auto-populated fields.

nodes.label: Capture Trouble Ticket Details
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to fill the Trouble Ticket details manually.

nodes.label: Select TT Type, Area, Sub-Area
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to select Source, Category, Area and Sub Area by searching keywords and referring to the knowledge base.

nodes.label: Cascading Area / Sub-Area Picklist
nodes.desc: The system shall dynamically filter the Sub Area picklist based on the selected Area so that only mapped and valid Sub Area values are available.

nodes.label: Select Description Template
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to use the correct description template from the knowledge base and update the Trouble Ticket description.

nodes.label: Save Ticket Details
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to save the Trouble Ticket details after all mandatory fields are filled.

nodes.label: Pass Ticket Details Downstream
nodes.desc: The system shall pass the captured Trouble Ticket details to downstream systems when the ticket is saved.

nodes.label: Description Template Administration
nodes.desc: A user holding the Template Administration privilege shall be able to create, amend and retire description templates.

nodes.label: Assign New Ticket to Creator
nodes.desc: The system shall automatically assign the newly created ticket to the creator of the ticket.

nodes.label: Priority Derivation from Customer Type
nodes.desc: The System shall derive ticket Priority from Customer Type per the matrix.

nodes.label: Auto-Assign Ticket to Queue
nodes.desc: The system shall assign the ticket to the appropriate queue using the predefined combination of Source, TT Category, Area, Sub Area, Language, Customer Type and TT Queue.

nodes.label: Generic Queue Fallback
nodes.desc: The system shall assign the ticket to a Generic Queue when the auto-assignment parameters do not match any predefined combination.

nodes.label: View Tickets in Agent Queue
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to view tickets assigned to the applicable queue, including generic and auto-assigned queues.

nodes.label: Queue-Scoped Work List
nodes.desc: The system shall assign tickets automatically to a queue assuming agents in the queue have the appropriate privileges and rights.

nodes.label: Supervisor Cross-Queue Assignment
nodes.desc: An agent acting as supervisor shall be able to assign the Trouble Ticket to a different queue.

nodes.label: Status/Sub-Status → Assigned
nodes.desc: The System shall set Status to 'Assigned' and Sub-Status to 'Assigned' when a ticket is allocated to a named user or user queue.

nodes.label: Self Assignment
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to assign a Trouble Ticket to self.

nodes.label: Receive Supervisor Assignment
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to receive a Trouble Ticket assigned by the supervisor.

nodes.label: Assignment Rejection
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to reject a ticket assigned to them, setting Sub-Status to 'Rejected'.

nodes.label: Restrict Team Member Reassignment
nodes.desc: The system shall not allow Trouble Ticket assignment among team members.

nodes.label: Assignment Email Notification
nodes.desc: The agent shall receive an email after a Trouble Ticket is assigned to the agent.

nodes.label: Select Multiple Tickets
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to select multiple Trouble Tickets based on filter criteria.

nodes.label: Select All Applicable Tickets
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to select all tickets in one action before or after applying filter criteria.

nodes.label: Bulk Assign to Target Queue
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to bulk assign selected Trouble Tickets to the proper target queue.

nodes.label: Restrict Bulk Assignment by Privileges
nodes.desc: The system shall permit bulk assignment only in accordance with the agent privileges and rights.

nodes.label: Single Bulk Assignment Target
nodes.desc: The system shall allow a bulk assignment to only one target entity.

nodes.label: Parent-Child Ticket Association
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to associate related Trouble Tickets manually as child of the master ticket.

nodes.label: Related Ticket Match Criteria
nodes.desc: The system shall allow tickets to be marked as associated when TT Category, MSISDN, Area and Sub Area match.

nodes.label: Associate Duplicate Ticket Manually
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to associate duplicate Trouble Tickets manually.

nodes.label: Duplicate Candidate Detection
nodes.desc: The system shall allow tickets to be marked as duplicate when TT Category, MSISDN, Area and Sub Area match.

nodes.label: Scan-to-Attach (Retail)
nodes.desc: An Agent holding the Retail Agent role shall be able to scan a physical document and attach it to the ticket.

nodes.label: Manual File Attachment
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to attach files while the ticket is in any non-terminal Status.

nodes.label: Block Attachments on Terminal Status
nodes.desc: The System shall not permit new attachments where Status is 'Closed' or 'Cancelled'.

nodes.label: Attachment View & Download
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view and download attachments in any Status including terminal ones, subject to role permission.

nodes.label: Attachment Constraints
nodes.desc: The System shall enforce a maximum file size, a permitted file-type whitelist and a maximum attachment count per ticket, and shall scan every uploaded file for malware before storage.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Capture
nodes.desc: The System shall record every Status change, Sub-Status change, field change, assignment change, attachment action and notification dispatch, capturing actor, timestamp, before value and after value.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Access
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view the audit trail from the detailed ticket view, subject to role permission.

nodes.label: Access Logging with Source Attribution
nodes.desc: The System shall log ticket access events including user identity, IP address, geo-location where available and access channel.

nodes.label: Create Manual Activity
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to add an activity manually under a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Associate Activity to Ticket
nodes.desc: The system shall associate each created activity with the Trouble Ticket under which it was created.

nodes.label: View Ticket Activities
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to view activities created under the Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Create Automatic Activity
nodes.desc: The system shall automatically create an activity at defined trigger points.

nodes.label: Close Open Activity
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to close activities created under the ticket when they are not closed automatically.

nodes.label: Close Activities on Ticket Closure
nodes.desc: The system shall close all activities associated with the Trouble Ticket when the ticket status moves to Closed.

nodes.label: Activity Visibility and Closure
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view all activities on a ticket, manual and system-generated, and close any that remain open.

nodes.label: AI-Assisted Ticket Creation and Triage
nodes.desc: The System shall provide an AI-assisted journey that contextualises the reported issue, pre-populates ticket fields, recommends TT Type and Priority, and proposes routing.

nodes.label: B2B and Enterprise Trouble Tickets
nodes.desc: The System shall support trouble tickets against B2B and enterprise accounts, including account-hierarchy context and the enterprise Customer Types in the SLA matrix.

nodes.label: Send Automatic SMS
nodes.desc: The system shall send a preconfigured SMS to the customer at defined events.

nodes.label: Automatic SMS Combination
nodes.desc: The system shall trigger automatic SMS using the defined combination of TT Source, TT Category, TT Area, TT Sub Area and TT Queue.

nodes.label: SMS Language Selection
nodes.desc: The system shall send the automatic SMS in the preferred language recorded on the customer account.

nodes.label: Send Manual SMS
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to send a manual SMS to the customer.

nodes.label: Search SMS Template
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to search for the correct SMS template using Keyword, TT Source, TT Category, TT Area, TT Sub Area and TT Status.

nodes.label: Filter Template by Number/Type/Language/Keyword
nodes.desc: The system shall filter SMS templates in the sequence Number, Service Type, Language and Keyword.

nodes.label: Manual SMS Language Selection
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to select Hindi, English, Malayalam or Arabic for a manual SMS.

nodes.label: Select SMS Template
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to select an SMS template for the Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Edit SMS Subject to Role
nodes.desc: The system shall allow MSISDN, Language and text to be edited based on the agent role and access, with Frontline unable to edit text and Back Office able to edit text.

nodes.label: Save SMS in Interaction History
nodes.desc: The system shall save SMS sent to the customer in Interaction History.

nodes.label: Additional Notification Channels
nodes.desc: The System shall support WhatsApp and mobile app push as additional customer notification channels, selectable by template and consented contact preference.

nodes.label: SLA Breach → Escalate Status
nodes.desc: The System shall able to escalate the ticket and change the status as 'Escalate' automatically when SLA is breached as per defined SLA matrix.

nodes.label: SLA Breach Notification
nodes.desc: The System shall send SLA breach notifications to the configured recipients at each of the three notification tiers defined for the ticket's Customer Type in the SLA matrix (Configurable Parameters P-04 to P-09).

nodes.label: SLA Breach RAG Status Update
nodes.desc: The System shall update the RAG status as per defined in SLA matrix.

nodes.label: SLA Notification as Siebel Activity
nodes.desc: The System shall create an Activity record for each SLA notification issued.

nodes.label: Manual Escalation with Reason
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to escalate a ticket manually by selecting a mandatory escalation reason from a controlled list.

nodes.label: Escalation Rejected — No Reason
nodes.desc: A manual escalation submitted without a mandatory escalation reason is rejected and not processed.

nodes.label: Escalation Notification to Distribution Lists
nodes.desc: The System shall send an email notification to every distribution list mapped to the assigned queue when a ticket is escalated.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Escalation Notification
nodes.desc: The System shall identify and notify the next higher position in the Siebel position hierarchy relative to the ticket owner when a ticket is escalated. When no higher position exists, the assigned queue distribution list is notified instead.

nodes.label: Distribution List Configuration
nodes.desc: A user holding the Distribution List Administration privilege shall be able to add, amend and remove multiple distribution lists mapped to a queue.

nodes.label: Rejected-Assignment View
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view escalated tickets using the 'escalated to me' and 'rejected by me' filters in a separate dashboard.

nodes.label: Mandatory Fields Gate on Solved
nodes.desc: The System shall prevent a ticket from transitioning to Status 'Solved' until Resolution Code, Hashtag and TT Actual Issue are populated. Missing fields are identified to the agent and the transition is blocked until they are complete.

nodes.label: Single Resolution Code
nodes.desc: The System shall permit the selection of exactly one Resolution Code per ticket.

nodes.label: Hashtag Capture with Filtering
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to select one or more Hashtags from a picklist filtered by TT Type, Area and Sub-Area.

nodes.label: Hashtag Administration
nodes.desc: A user holding the Reference Data Administration privilege shall be able to add and retire Hashtag values.

nodes.label: Actual Issue Capture with Filtering
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to select TT Actual Issue from a picklist filtered by the selected description template.

nodes.label: Actual Issue Administration
nodes.desc: A user holding the Reference Data Administration privilege shall be able to add and retire TT Actual Issue values.

nodes.label: L3 Referral Reference Capture
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to record an external L3 ticket reference in a dedicated validated field while the ticket remains in Status 'Not Solved'.

nodes.label: Transition to Completed
nodes.desc: The System shall permit a ticket to transition to Status 'Completed' only when no relevant activities remain outstanding. Outstanding activities are identified to the agent and block the transition.

nodes.label: Ticket Closure
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to set a ticket Status to 'Closed', and the System shall close all activities associated with the ticket.

nodes.label: Ticket Reopen
nodes.desc: A user holding the Reopen privilege shall be able to return a ticket from Status 'Closed' to Status 'Not Solved' within the configured reopen window by providing a mandatory reason.

nodes.label: Reopen Rejected — Outside Window
nodes.desc: An attempt to reopen a ticket outside the configured reopen window is rejected, with guidance to raise a linked ticket instead.

nodes.label: Ticket Cancellation
nodes.desc: A user holding the Cancellation privilege shall be able to set a ticket Status to 'Cancelled' by selecting a mandatory reason code.

nodes.label: Automatic Resolution for Port-Out Verification
nodes.desc: The System shall automatically resolve Port-Out verification tickets and shall permit a back-office agent to set Status to 'Solved' when the automated process fails.

nodes.label: Trigger Customer Satisfaction Survey
nodes.desc: The system shall send a feedback survey trigger to Medelia when the Trouble Ticket is in Resolved status.

nodes.label: Restrict Survey Trigger to Resolved Status
nodes.desc: The system shall send the Medelia survey trigger only when the Trouble Ticket status is Resolved.

nodes.label: CSAT Response Attribution
nodes.desc: The System shall store the survey response against the originating ticket and make it visible in the ticket view and in reporting.

nodes.label: Ticket List View with Filters
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view tickets in a list filtered by the criteria defined in field set FS-09.

nodes.label: Export List of Tickets
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to export list of tickets after applying the filters in an excel format.

nodes.label: Standard Siebel Ticket Views
nodes.desc: The System shall provide My Trouble Tickets, My Team's Trouble Tickets and All Trouble Tickets views.

nodes.label: Queue-Restricted Ticket Views
nodes.desc: The System shall restrict tickets assigned to the Back Office Queue and Credit Control / Collection Queue to members of the applicable queue.

nodes.label: Customer 360 Ticket Panel
nodes.desc: The Agent shall be able to view all Trouble Tickets raised against a customer account from Customer 360, without restriction on ticket age.

nodes.label: RAG Status Indicator
nodes.desc: The System shall display a Red, Amber or Green indicator for each ticket in list views, derived from elapsed time against the SLA target for the applicable Customer Type.

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket Lifecycle Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal state: the Trouble Ticket lifecycle concludes with the ticket resolved, closed, cancelled or reported on.

flows.label: System-generated activity feeds the same view
Automation failure escalated to back-office, then feedback on eventual Resolved

agents.Name: Qnomy
agents.Relationship: Queue and ticketing for journey initiation

agents.Name: DXP
agents.Relationship: Digital experience platform UI for agents
agents.Purpose / Feature: Agent-facing UI across ticket creation, search, dashboards

agents.Name: Siebel CRM
agents.Relationship: System of record for Trouble Ticket lifecycle
agents.Purpose / Feature: Ticket, assignment, SLA, audit, resolution processing

agents.Name: Medelia / Medallia
agents.Relationship: Customer satisfaction survey dispatch and response capture

agents.Name: AIA
agents.Relationship: Order creation request source; failure triggers automatic TT

start.title: Agent Login Trigger
start.does: Agent submits Agent ID and password to the system.
start.example: Agent enters credentials at the DXP login screen.

cred_validate.title: Validate Credentials
cred_validate.does: Checks Agent ID and credentials before granting access.

role_access.title: Role-Based Access
role_access.does: Applies role-based view/edit options after login.
role_access.example: Frontline agent sees a restricted option set vs Back Office.

agent360.title: View Agent 360
agent360.does: Agent opens the Agent 360 view after login.

agent_dash.title: Agent Dashboard
agent_dash.does: Displays tickets and tasks assigned to the logged-in agent.
agent_dash.example: Agent dashboard lists only the logged-in agent's work items.

validate_qticket.title: Validate Q Ticket & Identify Customer
validate_qticket.does: Agent validates the Q Ticket and identifies the customer before starting a Trouble Ticket.
validate_qticket.example: Agent confirms the queue ticket before opening a TT.

cust_id.title: Customer Identification
cust_id.does: Agent completes customer identification before ticket initiation.
cust_id.example: Agent matches the caller to an account.

nav_cust360.title: Navigate to Customer 360
nav_cust360.does: Agent opens Customer 360 before initiating the ticket.
nav_cust360.example: BR-001: a Trouble Ticket may only be created when verified Customer, Service Account and Billing Account context exists.

verify_idwise.title: Verify by IDwise
verify_idwise.does: Retail agent scans the customer ID via IDwise for verification.
verify_idwise.example: Retail agent scans ID before creating the ticket.

verify_telesales.title: Verify by Telesales/Retail Question
verify_telesales.does: Telesales or Retail agent verifies the customer by asking a verification question.
verify_telesales.example: Lightweight verification for Telesales/Retail/Call Centre agents (CAP-35).

smart_search.title: Smart Search for Categorisation
smart_search.does: Agent searches by keyword to find the applicable ticket category.
smart_search.example: BR-002: minimum 3 characters before suggestions return.

create_tt.title: Create Manual Trouble Ticket
create_tt.does: System creates a ticket with a unique Ticket ID for the selected category.
create_tt.example: Manual ticket creation from Service Request, Trouble Ticket or Query category.

auto_populate.title: Auto-Populate Ticket Fields
auto_populate.does: System auto-populates designated ticket fields from the source of record.
auto_populate.example: BR-003: auto-populated fields use the approved source of record; override needs an authorised role.

manual_fields.title: Capture Manually Filled Fields
manual_fields.does: Agent enters the designated manually-filled ticket fields.
manual_fields.example: BR-004: the creating agent is accountable for completeness/accuracy of manually entered fields.

auto_tt_order_fail.title: Automatic TT on Order Failure
auto_tt_order_fail.does: System auto-creates a Trouble Ticket when an AIA order creation request fails.
auto_tt_order_fail.makes: Trouble Ticket with error reason, error code returned to AIA
auto_tt_order_fail.example: AIA order failure automatically raises a TT and records the error reason.

kb_access.title: Knowledge Base Access
kb_access.does: Agent opens the Knowledge Base in another tab from a button.
kb_access.example: BR-005: categorisation/handling guidance uses current, approved Knowledge Base content.

view_new_tt.title: View Newly Created Trouble Ticket
view_new_tt.does: Agent views the newly created ticket with auto-populated fields visible.
view_new_tt.example: Ticket opens showing auto-populated fields after creation.

capture_tt_details.title: Capture Trouble Ticket Details
capture_tt_details.does: Agent manually fills Trouble Ticket details.
capture_tt_details.example: Agent enters/retains manually filled TT details.

select_type_area.title: Select TT Type, Area, Sub-Area
select_type_area.does: Agent selects Source, Category, Area and Sub Area via search/knowledge base.
select_type_area.example: Agent classifies the ticket via search and KB reference.

cascade_subarea.title: Cascading Area / Sub-Area Picklist
cascade_subarea.does: System filters the Sub Area picklist to only valid values for the selected Area.
cascade_subarea.example: Choosing an Area narrows the Sub Area list to valid mappings.

desc_template.title: Select Description Template
desc_template.does: Agent selects and applies a description template to update the ticket description.
desc_template.example: BR-006: description template must be active, approved and applicable to the selected classification.

save_ticket.title: Save Ticket Details
save_ticket.does: Agent saves the ticket once mandatory fields are populated.
save_ticket.example: Save succeeds only when mandatory fields are populated.

pass_downstream.title: Pass Ticket Details Downstream
pass_downstream.does: System forwards saved ticket details to downstream systems.
pass_downstream.example: Saving the ticket triggers downstream propagation.

desc_template_admin.title: Description Template Administration
desc_template_admin.does: Privileged user creates, amends and retires description templates.

assign_creator.title: Assign New Ticket to Creator
assign_creator.does: System auto-assigns a newly created ticket to its creating agent.

priority_derive.title: Priority Derivation from Customer Type
priority_derive.does: System derives ticket Priority from the Customer Type matrix; non-privileged users cannot override it.
priority_derive.example: Priority set automatically at creation per the Customer Type matrix.

auto_assign_queue.title: Auto-Assign Ticket to Queue
auto_assign_queue.does: System matches ticket attributes to a predefined queue combination.
auto_assign_queue.needs: Source, TT Category, Area, Sub Area, Language, Customer Type, TT Queue
auto_assign_queue.example: Ticket routed to the matching queue.

generic_queue.title: Generic Queue Fallback
generic_queue.does: System assigns an unmatched ticket to the Generic Queue.
generic_queue.example: Fallback routing when no predefined combination matches.

queue_view.title: View Tickets in Agent Queue
queue_view.does: Agent views tickets in their applicable queue (generic or auto-assigned).
queue_view.example: Queue view surfaces both generic and auto-assigned tickets.

queue_privilege.title: Queue-Scoped Work List
queue_privilege.does: System assumes queue agents hold the appropriate privileges/rights for automatic assignment.
queue_privilege.example: Automatic queue assignment presumes correct agent privileges.

supervisor_reassign.title: Supervisor Cross-Queue Assignment
supervisor_reassign.does: Supervisor reassigns a Trouble Ticket to a different queue.
supervisor_reassign.example: Supervisor override of automatic/generic queue assignment.

status_assigned.title: Status/Sub-Status → Assigned
status_assigned.does: System sets Status and Sub-Status to Assigned when a ticket is allocated.
status_assigned.example: Allocation to a user/queue records the assignment.

self_assign.title: Self Assignment
self_assign.does: Agent assigns a Trouble Ticket to themself.
self_assign.example: Agent pulls a ticket from the queue.

receive_supervisor_assign.title: Receive Supervisor Assignment
receive_supervisor_assign.does: Agent receives a ticket assigned by a supervisor.

reject_assignment.title: Assignment Rejection
reject_assignment.does: Agent rejects an assigned ticket; Sub-Status changes to Rejected.
reject_assignment.example: Rejection makes the ticket available for reallocation and logs the reason.

restrict_team_reassign.title: Restrict Team Member Reassignment
restrict_team_reassign.does: System blocks assignment attempts between team members.
restrict_team_reassign.example: Assignment among peers on the same team is not permitted.

assign_email.title: Assignment Email Notification
assign_email.does: Agent receives an email when a ticket is assigned to them.
assign_email.example: Assignment triggers an email notification via the Enterprise SMTP Relay.

select_multi.title: Select Multiple Tickets
select_multi.does: Agent selects more than one ticket from filtered results.

select_all.title: Select All Applicable Tickets
select_all.does: Agent selects all tickets matching the filter in one action.

bulk_assign.title: Bulk Assign to Target Queue
bulk_assign.does: Agent bulk-assigns selected tickets to a target queue.
bulk_assign.example: Bulk action assigns every selected ticket to one queue.

bulk_privilege.title: Restrict Bulk Assignment by Privileges
bulk_privilege.does: System permits bulk assignment only for agents with the required privileges.

bulk_single_target.title: Single Bulk Assignment Target
bulk_single_target.does: System restricts a bulk assignment action to exactly one target entity.
bulk_single_target.example: One bulk action cannot fan out to multiple targets.

parent_child_assoc.title: Parent-Child Ticket Association
parent_child_assoc.does: Agent manually links a related ticket as a child of the master ticket.

related_match.title: Related Ticket Match Criteria
related_match.does: System permits association when TT Category, MSISDN, Area and Sub Area match.
related_match.needs: TT Category, MSISDN, Area, Sub Area

assoc_duplicate.title: Associate Duplicate Ticket Manually
assoc_duplicate.does: Agent manually marks and associates a duplicate ticket.

dup_detect.title: Duplicate Candidate Detection
dup_detect.does: System permits marking tickets as duplicate on matching TT Category/MSISDN/Area/Sub Area.
dup_detect.needs: TT Category, MSISDN, Area, Sub Area
dup_detect.example: Matching criteria gate for duplicate marking.

scan_attach_retail.title: Scan-to-Attach (Retail)
scan_attach_retail.does: Retail Agent scans a physical document and attaches it to the ticket.
scan_attach_retail.example: Scan control shown only to Retail Agents.

manual_attach.title: Manual File Attachment
manual_attach.does: Agent attaches files while the ticket is non-terminal.
manual_attach.example: Attachments allowed until the ticket reaches a terminal status.

attach_terminal_block.title: Block Attachments on Terminal Status
attach_terminal_block.does: System blocks new attachments once Status is Closed or Cancelled.
attach_terminal_block.makes: Blocked attachment attempt / API business error

attach_view_download.title: Attachment View & Download
attach_view_download.does: Permitted user views/downloads attachments at any ticket status.
attach_view_download.example: Viewing/downloading is allowed regardless of ticket status.

attach_constraints.title: Attachment Constraints
attach_constraints.does: System enforces file size/type/count limits and malware scanning before storage.
attach_constraints.example: A non-compliant file is rejected with a specific reason, not partially stored.

audit_capture.title: Audit Trail Capture
audit_capture.does: System records every status/field/assignment/attachment/notification event with actor and before/after values.
audit_capture.example: BR-007: once created, an audit record must not be modified or deleted.

audit_access.title: Audit Trail Access
audit_access.does: Permitted user views the chronological audit trail from the detailed ticket view.
audit_access.example: Audit records cannot be edited or deleted by the viewer.

access_logging.title: Access Logging with Source Attribution
access_logging.does: System logs ticket access events with identity, IP, geo-location and channel.
access_logging.example: BR-008: retained for authorised audit, security and privacy review per retention policy.

create_activity.title: Create Manual Activity
create_activity.does: Agent adds an activity manually under the Trouble Ticket.
create_activity.example: BR-009: activity must identify its business purpose and responsible agent.

assoc_activity.title: Associate Activity to Ticket
assoc_activity.does: System links each activity to its parent Trouble Ticket.
assoc_activity.example: Activities are always traceable to their ticket.

view_activities.title: View Ticket Activities
view_activities.does: Agent views manual and automatic activities under the ticket.
view_activities.example: BR-010: activities viewable only by users authorised for the parent ticket.

auto_activity.title: Create Automatic Activity
auto_activity.does: System auto-creates an activity at approved business trigger points.
auto_activity.example: BR-011: automatic activities only for approved trigger points.

close_activity.title: Close Open Activity
close_activity.does: Agent manually closes an open activity.
close_activity.example: BR-012: only the owner or an authorised role may close an activity.

close_on_ticket_close.title: Close Activities on Ticket Closure
close_on_ticket_close.does: System closes all associated activities when the ticket is closed.
close_on_ticket_close.example: Ticket closure cascades to its activities.

activity_visibility.title: Activity Visibility and Closure
activity_visibility.does: Agent views manual and system-generated activities with origin, and closes open ones.
activity_visibility.makes: Displayed activities with origin, closure action

ai_triage.title: AI-Assisted Ticket Creation and Triage
ai_triage.does: AI journey contextualises the issue, pre-populates fields, and proposes TT Type/Priority/routing.
ai_triage.makes: Proposed TT Type, Area, Sub-Area, Priority, routing (agent can accept/override)
ai_triage.example: AI-assisted triage journey with agent override.

b2b_tickets.title: B2B and Enterprise Trouble Tickets
b2b_tickets.does: System supports TTs against B2B/enterprise accounts with hierarchy context and enterprise SLA.
b2b_tickets.makes: TT with account-hierarchy context, enterprise SLA applied
b2b_tickets.example: Enterprise account handling for Trouble Tickets.

auto_sms.title: Send Automatic SMS
auto_sms.does: System sends a preconfigured SMS to the customer at defined events.

auto_sms_combo.title: Automatic SMS Combination
auto_sms_combo.does: System maps TT Source/Category/Area/Sub Area/Queue combinations to automatic SMS triggers.
auto_sms_combo.needs: TT Source, Category, Area, Sub Area, Queue

sms_lang.title: SMS Language Selection
sms_lang.does: Automatic SMS defaults to the customer's preferred account language.
sms_lang.example: Language defaults from the customer account.

manual_sms.title: Send Manual SMS
manual_sms.does: Agent sends a manual SMS to the customer.
manual_sms.example: BR-013: only an authorised agent, to an approved contact, per consent.

search_sms_template.title: Search SMS Template
search_sms_template.does: Agent searches for the correct SMS template using multiple filter criteria.

filter_template.title: Filter Template by Number/Type/Language/Keyword
filter_template.does: System filters templates in the sequence Number, Service Type, Language, Keyword.
filter_template.example: Sequenced filter narrows the template list.

manual_sms_lang.title: Manual SMS Language Selection
manual_sms_lang.does: Agent selects one of four supported languages for a manual SMS.

select_sms_template.title: Select SMS Template
select_sms_template.does: Agent selects a template for the manual SMS.
select_sms_template.example: BR-014: only active/approved templates applicable to the TT.

edit_sms_role.title: Edit SMS Subject to Role
edit_sms_role.does: System restricts SMS text editing by role: Frontline cannot edit text, Back Office can.

save_sms_history.title: Save SMS in Interaction History
save_sms_history.does: System records the sent SMS as an Interaction History entry.
save_sms_history.example: Sent SMS becomes visible in Interaction History.

additional_channels.title: Additional Notification Channels
additional_channels.does: System supports WhatsApp and mobile push, gated by template and consent.
additional_channels.example: WhatsApp/push extend the SMS notification channel set.

sla_breach_escalate.title: SLA Breach → Escalate Status
sla_breach_escalate.does: System auto-escalates and sets Status to Escalate when the SLA threshold is breached.
sla_breach_escalate.example: BR-015: first SLA notification issued per the Customer Type SLA matrix.

sla_breach_notify.title: SLA Breach Notification
sla_breach_notify.does: System sends notifications at each of the three SLA tiers for the ticket's Customer Type.
sla_breach_notify.makes: Notification to configured recipients, linked Activity record
sla_breach_notify.example: Three-tier notification schedule per Customer Type (non-Expatriate/Expatriate).

sla_rag_update.title: SLA Breach RAG Status Update
sla_rag_update.does: System updates the RAG indicator per the SLA matrix thresholds.
sla_rag_update.example: RAG reflects elapsed time against the applicable Customer Type SLA target.

sla_activity_log.title: SLA Notification as Siebel Activity
sla_activity_log.does: System logs one Activity record per SLA notification issued.
sla_activity_log.makes: Siebel Activity record (ticket ref, tier, timestamp)
sla_activity_log.example: Every SLA notification is independently auditable via an Activity record.

manual_escalation.title: Manual Escalation with Reason
manual_escalation.does: Agent escalates manually, selecting a mandatory reason from a controlled list.
manual_escalation.example: Submission without a reason is rejected; a valid reason issues notifications and logs the event.

manual_escalation_rejected.title: Escalation Rejected — No Reason
manual_escalation_rejected.does: Escalation submission without a mandatory reason is rejected and not processed.
manual_escalation_rejected.makes: Rejected submission, agent prompted to select a reason
manual_escalation_rejected.example: Validation failure path for manual escalation.

esc_dist_notify.title: Escalation Notification to Distribution Lists
esc_dist_notify.does: System emails every distribution list mapped to the ticket's assigned queue on escalation.
esc_dist_notify.example: Escalation fans out to all mapped distribution lists.

esc_hierarchy_notify.title: Hierarchical Escalation Notification
esc_hierarchy_notify.does: System notifies the next-higher Siebel position above the ticket owner on escalation.
esc_hierarchy_notify.makes: Notification to next-higher position (or queue DL if none)
esc_hierarchy_notify.example: Falls back to the assigned queue distribution list when no higher position exists.

dist_list_admin.title: Distribution List Configuration
dist_list_admin.does: Privileged user manages distribution lists mapped to a queue.
dist_list_admin.example: Admin maintenance of escalation distribution lists.

rejected_view.title: Rejected-Assignment View
rejected_view.does: Agent filters a dashboard by 'escalated to me' and 'rejected by me'.
rejected_view.example: Two dedicated filters scoped to the logged-in agent.

solved_gate.title: Mandatory Fields Gate on Solved
solved_gate.does: System blocks the transition to Solved until Resolution Code, Hashtag and TT Actual Issue are populated.
solved_gate.needs: Resolution Code, Hashtag, TT Actual Issue
solved_gate.example: Gate ensures resolution data completeness before Solved.

resolution_code.title: Single Resolution Code
resolution_code.does: System restricts a ticket to exactly one Resolution Code; reselection replaces it.
resolution_code.example: One Resolution Code per ticket, replaceable not additive.

hashtag_capture.title: Hashtag Capture with Filtering
hashtag_capture.does: Agent selects one or more Hashtags from a picklist filtered by TT Type/Area/Sub-Area.
hashtag_capture.example: Filtered Hashtag picklist scoped to the ticket's classification.

hashtag_admin.title: Hashtag Administration
hashtag_admin.does: Privileged user adds and retires Hashtag reference values.
hashtag_admin.example: Retired values excluded from new-ticket picklists.

actual_issue_capture.title: Actual Issue Capture with Filtering
actual_issue_capture.does: Agent selects TT Actual Issue from a picklist filtered by the description template.

actual_issue_admin.title: Actual Issue Administration
actual_issue_admin.does: Privileged user adds and retires TT Actual Issue reference values.
actual_issue_admin.makes: Updated Actual Issue catalogue, audit entry
actual_issue_admin.example: Admin maintenance of Actual Issue reference data.

l3_referral.title: L3 Referral Reference Capture
l3_referral.does: Agent records an external L3 ticket reference while status remains Not Solved.
l3_referral.example: Recording the L3 reference does not change ticket Status.

complete_gate.title: Transition to Completed
complete_gate.does: System blocks transition to Completed while relevant activities remain open.
complete_gate.example: Gate ensures activity completeness before Completed.

ticket_closure.title: Ticket Closure
ticket_closure.does: Agent closes the ticket; system closes all associated activities using the same timestamp.
ticket_closure.example: Closure cascades to all associated activities.

ticket_reopen.title: Ticket Reopen
ticket_reopen.does: Privileged user reopens a Closed ticket to Not Solved within the reopen window, with a mandatory reason.
ticket_reopen.makes: Status = Not Solved, reopen count incremented, or rejection with linked-ticket guidance
ticket_reopen.example: Outside the window, reopen is rejected and a linked ticket is advised.

reopen_rejected.title: Reopen Rejected — Outside Window
reopen_rejected.does: Reopen attempt outside the configured window is rejected.
reopen_rejected.example: Agent is directed to raise a linked ticket instead of reopening.

ticket_cancel.title: Ticket Cancellation
ticket_cancel.does: Privileged user cancels the ticket with a mandatory reason code.
ticket_cancel.makes: Status = Cancelled, excluded from performance reporting
ticket_cancel.example: Cancelled tickets are excluded from performance reporting.

portout_auto_resolve.title: Automatic Resolution for Port-Out Verification
portout_auto_resolve.does: System auto-resolves Port-Out verification tickets; on automation failure, a back-office agent can manually set Solved.
portout_auto_resolve.makes: Status = Solved, response sent to MNP gateway
portout_auto_resolve.example: Manual fallback for back-office agents when the automated process fails.

cust_feedback_trigger.title: Trigger Customer Satisfaction Survey
cust_feedback_trigger.does: System sends a survey trigger to Medelia when the ticket reaches Resolved.
cust_feedback_trigger.example: Resolved status is the sole trigger condition.

restrict_survey.title: Restrict Survey Trigger to Resolved Status
restrict_survey.does: System withholds the survey trigger until the ticket reaches Resolved.

csat_attribution.title: CSAT Response Attribution
csat_attribution.does: System stores the survey response against the originating ticket, visible in the ticket view and reporting.
csat_attribution.example: Survey response linked back to the originating ticket.

list_view_filters.title: Ticket List View with Filters
list_view_filters.does: Agent views a filtered ticket list and can save/reapply the filter.
list_view_filters.example: Saved filters can be reapplied by the agent.

export_tickets.title: Export List of Tickets
export_tickets.does: Agent exports the filtered ticket list to Excel.
export_tickets.example: Export contains only tickets matching the applied filters.

std_views.title: Standard Siebel Ticket Views
std_views.does: System provides My/My Team's/All Trouble Tickets standard views.
std_views.example: Three standard scoping views for agents.

queue_restricted_views.title: Queue-Restricted Ticket Views
queue_restricted_views.does: System restricts Back Office/Credit Control queue tickets to queue members only.

cust360_panel.title: Customer 360 Ticket Panel
cust360_panel.does: Agent views all TTs raised against a customer account from Customer 360, regardless of age.
cust360_panel.example: No ticket-age restriction on the Customer 360 TT panel.

rag_indicator.title: RAG Status Indicator
rag_indicator.does: System displays a Red/Amber/Green indicator per ticket in list views.
rag_indicator.needs: Elapsed time vs Customer Type SLA target
rag_indicator.example: List-view RAG derived from the same SLA thresholds as SLA Monitoring.

end.title: Trouble Ticket Lifecycle Complete
end.does: Represents the end of the Trouble Ticket lifecycle covered by this BRSD.

contractPlain.BR-001: A Trouble Ticket may only be created once verified Customer, Service Account and Billing Account context exists.
contractPlain.BR-002: Ticket categorisation search requires at least three characters before suggestions appear.
contractPlain.BR-003: Auto-populated fields must use the approved source of record; only an authorised role may override them.
contractPlain.BR-004: The creating agent is accountable for the completeness and accuracy of manually entered fields.
contractPlain.BR-005: Ticket categorisation and handling guidance must use current, approved Knowledge Base content.
contractPlain.BR-006: The description template used must be active, approved and applicable to the ticket's classification.
contractPlain.BR-007: Once created, an audit record must never be modified or deleted.
contractPlain.BR-008: Ticket access information is retained for authorised audit, security and privacy review per the retention policy.
contractPlain.BR-009: A manually created activity must identify its business purpose and the responsible agent.
contractPlain.BR-010: Ticket activities may be viewed only by users authorised to access the parent ticket.
contractPlain.BR-011: Automatic activities are created only for approved business trigger points.
contractPlain.BR-012: An open activity may be closed only by its owner or another authorised role.
contractPlain.BR-013: Manual SMS may be sent only by an authorised agent, to an approved contact number, per the customer's contact permissions.
contractPlain.BR-014: Only active, approved SMS templates applicable to the ticket may be selected.
contractPlain.BR-015: The first SLA notification is issued per the Customer Type SLA matrix when ticket conditions are met.
